rows.prerequisite: Elemental system active and actor owns an elemental Magic attack
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, eligible AI
rows.effect: Whenever the actor's Magic exploits an elemental weakness, determine the ordinary weakness bonus exactly once and double that bonus contribution: +22% becomes +44%, and +66% becomes +132%. Do not double the entire final attack again and do not generate an extra weakness-table roll. Hit-stun, knockback, Content riders and Magic cost are not duplicated.

rows.name: Unnerving Presence
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with an eligible hit-stun source
rows.effect: After the normal ChaHitStunInflictMultiplier is calculated, multiply eligible hit stun inflicted by this actor by 2.00. This applies once per resolved target hit/event, not once per pellet or sub-hit, and remains subject to the ordinary retrigger guard, resistance, anti-stunlock rules, and hard caps. This is separate from the Menacing intimidation family: Unnerving Presence improves hit-stun pressure, while Menacing/Dreadful/Terrifying improve Morale pressure.

rows.name: Dazing Presence
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with an eligible hit-stun source
rows.effect: Replaces Unnerving Presence's feat multiplier with 3.00 total. It stacks multiplicatively with the continuous CHA-derived hit-stun multiplier but does not create hit stun on attacks that normally have none.

rows.name: Overwhelming Presence
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with an eligible hit-stun source
rows.effect: Replaces the lower-rank feat multiplier with 4.00 total. Weapon-specific and weakness multipliers still resolve afterward, and all anti-stunlock/retrigger/cap safeguards remain authoritative.

rows.name: Menacing
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: This is rank 1 of the dedicated offensive intimidation family. Adds +2 to MoraleDC whenever this actor is the credited attacker for a Morale check. AI actors may acquire this family through the same ordinary deterministic FeatDirector eligibility and selection rules as other AI-legal feats whenever their CHA and prerequisites qualify; it is not reserved for player characters. Against a human-controlled defender, also set HumanMoraleTraumaFraction = 0.30 for damage credited to this actor, so a single hit dealing more than 30% of current MaxHP may trigger Morale instead of the ordinary greater-than-one-third requirement. This never enables the below-50%-HP trigger or repeated-below-half trigger against humans. Against AI defenders, trigger cadence remains the ordinary AI Morale cadence; Menacing improves the opposed check rather than creating extra checks.

rows.name: Dreadful
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Replaces Menacing's +2 with +4 total MoraleDC. Against human-controlled defenders, replaces Menacing's trauma threshold with HumanMoraleTraumaFraction = 0.25, so a single hit dealing more than 25% of current MaxHP may trigger Morale. It still never enables a human below-50%-HP or repeated-below-half trigger. Dreadful replaces rather than stacks with Menacing's threshold and DC bonus.

rows.name: Terrifying
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Retains Dreadful's +4 total MoraleDC. Against human-controlled defenders, replaces Dreadful's trauma threshold with HumanMoraleTraumaFraction = 0.20, so a single hit dealing more than 20% of current MaxHP may trigger Morale; it still never enables the below-50%-HP or repeated-below-half trigger against humans. In addition, the first Morale Save each eligible defender makes against this actor during an encounter is rolled twice and the lower natural d20 is kept before modifiers. Later Morale Saves by that defender against the same actor return to one d20. Terrifying therefore specializes an actor into intimidation by widening the set of genuinely traumatic hits against human-controlled targets and making its first fear attempt especially difficult, while the defender's controller-based Morale cooldown remains unchanged and continues to prevent repeated player lockout.

rows.name: Daunting
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with at least one eligible attributable damaging attack
rows.effect: Sets IntimidationProcChance = 0.55. If an eligible target-hit event damages a surviving defender whose MoraleCheckCooldown is inactive and that same event did not already require a Morale check from an ordinary trauma trigger, a successful proc forces exactly one Morale check even when the hit would otherwise be below the defender's trauma threshold. The ordinary attacker-CHA MoraleDC and defender-CHA MoraleSave formulas apply, and the normal controller-specific cooldown begins after that check whether it succeeds or fails.

rows.name: Cowing
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with at least one eligible attributable damaging attack
rows.effect: Replaces Daunting and sets IntimidationProcChance = 0.75. All one-check-per-damage-event, Morale cooldown, controller-specific failure, and anti-player-lockout rules remain unchanged.

rows.name: Overawing
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI with at least one eligible attributable damaging attack
rows.effect: Replaces Cowing and sets IntimidationProcChance = 0.95. All other Daunting-family semantics remain unchanged. Menacing→Dreadful→Terrifying is a separate complementary family: its MoraleDC bonuses, human trauma-threshold reductions, and Terrifying first-save disadvantage apply normally to Morale checks forced by this proc family, allowing deliberate investment in both frequency and potency without duplicate proc rolls.

rows.name: Panic Is Contagious
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: When an enemy fails a Morale Save against this actor, every other eligible AI hostile below 50% MaxHP within 2 graph cells may immediately make one Morale check against the same actor. A secondary failure does not recursively trigger another cascade, and each potential secondary target has a 3.0-second cascade-immunity timer.

rows.name: Point It Out
rows.actors: AI Watchers and human-controlled Soldiers only
rows.effect: After normal CHA SpotSystem formulas, add +1 SpotTargetRangeCells, +1 SpotDrawRangeCells, and +2 SpotMarkDurationSeconds, still respecting the global SpotSystem clamps and same-floor rule.

rows.name: Rally the Hunt
rows.actors: AI Watchers and human-controlled Soldiers only
rows.effect: Replaces the prior spotting bonus with +2 target-range cells, +2 draw-radius cells, and +4 mark-duration seconds total, subject to clamps and same-floor restrictions.

rows.name: Command the Hunt
rows.actors: AI Watchers and human-controlled Soldiers only
rows.effect: Replaces the prior spotting bonus with +3 target-range cells, +3 draw-radius cells, and +6 mark-duration seconds total, subject to clamps and same-floor restrictions.

rows.name: Abrasive Personality
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI
rows.effect: Rank 1 of the passive personality-aura family. Set PersonalityAuraCellRadius = 1. While this actor is alive and otherwise eligible, wait a fixed 3.0-second AuraPulseInterval; when it expires, every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 3x3 grid neighborhood centered on the owner takes PersonalityAuraDamage = max(0, CHA_MOD) flat untyped passive damage. This includes the owner's own cell plus every cell touching it by an edge or corner; equivalently, max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 1. After the pulse resolves, wait another full 3.0 seconds. The initial interval is also three seconds: no immediate first pulse, timing dice, catch-up burst or duplicated scheduler. Existing lifecycle, freeze and actor restrictions remain authoritative. PersonalityAuraDamage is not an attack, not physical, and not magical; it has no damage dice and therefore receives no per-die CON resistance. It is FeedbackIneligible=true, MoraleIneligible=true, StatusProcIneligible=true, and cannot trigger Bloodletter, Aggressive Personality, Self-Actualization, hit-stun, Push, wall-slam, or any other effect requiring an attributable offensive hit. Ordinary lethal handling and kill attribution still apply. Player-facing text describes this simply as ONE-CELL RADIUS rather than using a zero-radius or same-cell shorthand.

rows.name: Narcissism
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI
rows.effect: Replaces Abrasive Personality's radius while retaining the same max(0, CHA_MOD) flat damage, fixed 3.0-second pulse interval with a full initial wait and no catch-up burst, and passive-damage exclusions. Set PersonalityAuraCellRadius = 2. At each pulse, affect every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 5x5 grid neighborhood centered on the owner, equivalent to max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 2. The radius is cell-based rather than a raw world-unit sphere.

rows.name: Megalomania
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI
rows.effect: Replaces Narcissism's radius while retaining the same max(0, CHA_MOD) flat damage, fixed 3.0-second pulse interval with a full initial wait and no catch-up burst, and passive-damage exclusions. Set PersonalityAuraCellRadius = 3. At each pulse, affect every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 7x7 grid neighborhood centered on the owner, equivalent to max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 3. Higher ranks replace rather than stack with lower ranks, so one owner produces exactly one personality-aura pulse stream regardless of rank.

rows.name: Aura Burst
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with at least one discrete active Magic activation
rows.effect: Rank 1 of the triggered Magic-aura family. Set AuraBurstCellRadius = 1. Whenever this actor successfully initiates a discrete active Magic use that actually spends Magic, resolve exactly one AuraBurst pulse centered on the actor as an add-on to that Magic activation. AuraBurstDamage = max(0, CHA_MOD) flat magical aura damage to every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 3x3 grid neighborhood centered on the owner at the instant the Magic use begins: the owner's own cell plus every cell touching it by an edge or corner. Equivalently, max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 1. The burst is a separate supplemental damage event rather than additional damage dice on the triggering spell or ability; it does not inherit that Magic use's Form, Content, element, damage dice, Boom behavior, rider, targeting, or status effects. AuraBurstDamage has no damage dice and therefore receives no per-die CON resistance. It is magical=true but is not itself an active Magic activation, cannot recursively trigger Aura Burst, and is ineligible for Self-Actualization, ordinary offensive status procs, Bloodletter, hit-stun, Push, wall-slam, Feedback, or Morale. Ordinary magical-damage defenses such as True Faith may reduce it. Continuous or maintenance Magic drains, including map viewing, Float On, Arcane Shield diversion, passive regeneration, and other resource-over-time accounting, do not generate repeated bursts. Player-facing text describes this as ONE-CELL RADIUS.

rows.name: Radiance
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with at least one discrete active Magic activation
rows.effect: Replaces Aura Burst's radius while retaining the same one-pulse-per-discrete-Magic-activation trigger, max(0, CHA_MOD) flat magical AuraBurstDamage, and triggered-aura exclusions. Set AuraBurstCellRadius = 2. Each qualifying Magic activation affects every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 5x5 grid neighborhood centered on the owner, equivalent to max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 2. The radius is cell-based rather than a raw world-unit sphere.

rows.name: Majesty
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with at least one discrete active Magic activation
rows.effect: Replaces Radiance's radius while retaining the same one-pulse-per-discrete-Magic-activation trigger, max(0, CHA_MOD) flat magical AuraBurstDamage, and triggered-aura exclusions. Set AuraBurstCellRadius = 3. Each qualifying Magic activation affects every living hostile on the same canonical floor within the 7x7 grid neighborhood centered on the owner, equivalent to max(abs(TargetRow-OwnerRow), abs(TargetColumn-OwnerColumn)) <= 3. Higher ranks replace rather than stack with lower Aura Burst ranks, so one Magic activation produces exactly one AuraBurst pulse regardless of owned rank. Aura Burst/Radiance/Majesty and Abrasive Personality/Narcissism/Megalomania are independent feat families: an actor may own both, their eligibility and timers/triggers remain separate, and when both legitimately resolve against the same target their damage events both apply rather than one suppressing or replacing the other.

rows.name: Academic Achievement
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with a canonical Magic pool and passive Magic regeneration
rows.effect: Adds the owner's positive Charisma modifier to the same canonical passive Magic-regeneration calculation that normally uses Intelligence. Set AcademicRegenCHAContribution = max(0, CHA_MOD) and EffectiveMagicRegenModifier = INT_MOD + AcademicRegenCHAContribution, then compute MagicRegenMultiplier = clamp(1 + 0.10 × EffectiveMagicRegenModifier, 0.50, 2.00). This is cumulative with the ordinary INT contribution rather than replacing it. Academic Achievement changes only passive Magic regeneration speed: it does not enable regeneration while the canonical Magic system says regeneration is suspended, does not increase Max Magic, does not alter active Magic costs, map drain, spell damage, MagicSave, or any other INT/CHA rule, and cannot regenerate above the actor's ordinary Magic maximum.

rows.name: Self-Actualization
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with at least one eligible magical attack
rows.effect: Adds a flat outgoing damage bonus equal to max(0, CHA_MOD) to each eligible attributable magical attack or active damaging Magic event initiated by this actor. Apply the bonus exactly once per resolved target damage event after ordinary source-side damage multipliers; it does not alter die count, die size, Boom qualification, continuation generation, status-application chance, or Magic cost. Multi-target Magic may receive the bonus once for each genuinely damaged target, but individual damage dice, Boom continuations, pellets, cosmetic sub-hits, and other internal subcomponents never multiply it. Feedback, PoisonStepDamage, BleedTickDamage, ImmolatedDamage, environmental damage, reflected/reactive damage, and other non-attack or status-damage events are ineligible. Eligibility tests magical=true independently of any physical tag. A mixed physical=true/magical=true attack receives Self-Actualization and may also receive Aggressive Personality if the actor owns both feats, with each feat contributing its flat bonus once to the same resolved damage event.

rows.name: Aggressive Personality
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, and AI with at least one eligible physical attack
rows.effect: Aggressive Personality has a ready/cooldown state and is entirely range-independent. There is no feat radius, cell-distance or attacker-to-target range gate; a legal attributable physical attack qualifies at any distance. While ready, the next eligible attributable physical attack activation that produces at least one physical=true damage event may add a flat outgoing damage bonus equal to max(0, CHA_MOD) to each eligible resolved target damage event created by that same originating attack, regardless of whether those events are also tagged magical=true. Apply the bonus exactly once per legitimately damaged target event after ordinary source-side damage multipliers; it does not alter damage dice, Boom qualification, push distance, wall-slam dice, status-proc chances, or other rider mechanics. After that originating attack finishes resolving and the bonus has applied at least once, consume the ready state and roll AggressivePersonalityCooldownSeconds = 1d3 seconds. This cooldown d3 is a sealed non-damage utility die and never explodes or inherits Rogue die mastery, BoomShift, Wizard magical Boom rules, weapon-specific explosion rules, or other attack-die modifiers. While the cooldown is active, Aggressive Personality contributes no CHA damage and qualifying attacks do not restart, extend, or reroll the cooldown. When the cooldown expires, the feat becomes ready again. A Shotgun shell or other single authored multi-target attack checks readiness once for the originating attack and, when ready, may grant the bonus once per damaged target after ordinary aggregation; pellets or internal sub-hits never consume separate cooldowns. Each genuinely separate bullet or authored projectile fired as a separate attack activation must find the feat ready on its own. Push-only effects, wall-slam/crush damage, Feedback, status damage, environmental damage, and other non-attack or reactive damage are ineligible and do not consume readiness. A mixed physical=true/magical=true event remains eligible for Aggressive Personality and may also receive Self-Actualization if the actor owns both feats; the two independently satisfied damage-class predicates may therefore both contribute once. If Aggressive Personality is on cooldown, it contributes no CHA-derived damage for Glow Up or any other effect that keys off an actual CHA_MOD damage contribution.

rows.name: Winning Personality
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI using ordinary feat eligibility
rows.effect: On acquisition, permanently increase the actor's intrinsic CHA score by +1, subject to the ordinary permanent ability-score ceiling. This is a real CHA increase and therefore immediately participates in all ordinary CHA-derived calculations. For the sole purpose of checking the printed ability-score prerequisite of an INT feat, EffectiveINTFeatQualificationScore = max(INT, CHA), using the actor's current CHA after this +1 increase. Winning Personality does not change the actor's actual INT score or INT_MOD and never substitutes CHA for INT in gameplay formulas, Magic regeneration, Arcane Break or Arcane Integrity contests, Wizard class mechanics, feat-effect scaling, or any other INT-derived mechanic. All non-ability prerequisites and restrictions remain fully authoritative, including prerequisite feats, class exclusions, controller/weapon access, and ordinary feat availability. The substituted qualification score also applies when constructing legal feat-draft or AI FeatDirector candidate pools, so an INT feat unlocked by Winning Personality may appear through the ordinary selection process. The permanent +1 CHA remains useful even if the actor never selects or uses an INT feat through Winning Personality.

rows.name: Put Your Back Into It
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.str. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification STR reaches 30.

rows.name: Light Feet
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.dex. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification DEX reaches 30.

rows.name: Tough It Out
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.con. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification CON reaches 30.

rows.name: Quick Study
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.int. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification INT reaches 30.

rows.name: Keep Your Wits
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.wis. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification WIS reaches 30.

rows.name: Make an Impression
rows.actors: Heroes, human Soldiers, AI
rows.effect: Adds +1 permanent featAbilityDelta.cha. Repeatable across later feat opportunities until intrinsic FeatQualification CHA reaches 30.

rows.actors: Heroes
rows.effect: While the holder is living and authoritatively deployed in the active dungeon, contribute 60 seconds multiplied by the positive current effective Intelligence modifier, max(0, floor((EffectiveINT - 10) / 2)), to the shared collapse deadline. Use the existing effective-ability/derived-stat authority, including legitimate equipment changes, not a new stat calculation. Ordinary qualification and effect strength remain distinct: owning the feat does not require requalifying after every stat change. There is no Magic cost, cooldown, random roll, radius or same-floor restriction. Different eligible Hero identities stack additively; duplicate feat IDs, bodies, synchronization or deployment notifications never multiply one Hero's contribution. Presence and clock accounting are defined in the matching 05/06 supplements.
